fields.description: Issue includes political commentary and local satire criticizing Miami Mayor Everest G. Sewell and city commission actions, including discussion of Ordinance No. 1234 involving tax sale certificates and a mortgage connected to acquisition of the Roney Plaza Hotel property. Coverage also attacks State's Attorney Vernon Hawthorne's record in notable prosecutions (Zangara, Lancaster, and slot-machine cases), mentions St. Patrick's Day, and reports on local gambling and racing at Hialeah and Tropical Park, along with assorted society notes and advertisements for Miami nightlife and businesses.
